liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Smokestack Lightning** (3 reviews): Opens the tape hot; reviewer presumes it came right after the band got busted; Smokestack has a train-riding feel [4][11][13]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (3 reviews): Reviewer singles out the Lovelight as very nice; Garcia and Weir interplay in the soundboard section of Lovelight is singled out as exceptional [4][6][13]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Morning Dew is gorgeous, with effects suiting the song and Jerry joining Bobby on the high part [11]
- **St. Stephen** (1 review): The St. Stephen into Not Fade Away and back into St. Stephen sequence is called nice [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Seasons of My Heart**: rare: 6 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd70-02-08.sbd-aud.cousinit.18123.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 17 songs; 152 min; rated 2.8/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd70-02-08.sbd-aud.cribbs.17679.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 13 songs; 134 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: Low-generation audience tape that switches to a clean soundboard during Dark Star; board portion holds up solidly through the end [4]
- **gd70-02-08.sbd-aud.cotsman.19152.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 13 songs; 136 min; rated 3.54/5 by 13 [3]. Said about its sound: Better-than-average sound with a good overall mix, though the drums sit a bit low; Audience source is quite good throughout; reviewer takes the soundboard portions plus the whole Lovelight; Reviewer reports significant sound problems on the tape [5][6][13][14]

## Around the show

- Reviewer calls it only an average show within a great year [5]
- This Lovelight is unlike the ones played up to this date [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-02-08.sbd-aud.cousinit.18123.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by CousinIt; source: Audience patched with Soundboard [1]. Also: This is the most complete copy, and the sound is not much worse; One soundboard source (SBDa) supplies Dark Star from 18:08 through 22:34; A second soundboard source (SBDb) runs from 22:35 of Dark Star through 15:17 of Lovelight [1][12]
- **gd70-02-08.sbd-aud.cribbs.17679.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Andy Lemieux and Sean Cribbs; source: Audience patched with Soundboard [2]
- **gd70-02-08.sbd-aud.cotsman.19152.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Andy Lemieux, Sean Cribbs, JCotsman; source: Soundboard and Audience composite [3]
